artworks.title: Veue de la cour des Fontaines de Fontaine Beleau
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 37.4 x 49.8 cm (14 3/4 x 19 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural scene with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon features trees and ornate buildings including a palace or chateau with multiple steep roofs and chimneys. Fluffy clouds fill the sky. Tall trees frame the composition. The style includes precise lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of brown. Figures in period clothing are seen near us, along with horses and dogs. In the middle, there is a barge on a body of water. A tree-lined path extends into the distance.

artworks.title: The Handsome Barber
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The John U. and Evelyn S. Nef Collection
artworks.description: The image contains curved lines and swirling shapes, creating an abstract scene. A vertical line is in the center, surrounded by figures resembling people in conversation or grooming. Soft, flowing lines and watercolor effects create a relaxed atmosphere. The scene suggests an informal outdoor gathering under a stylized sky, with a hand reaching in from above.

artworks.title: A Monstrance with Two Angels Supporting a Chalice
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and brown ink, partially squared in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate architectural design featuring cherubs and ornamental elements. It shows a symmetrical structure consisting of a central urn with emanating rays, supported by two winged cherubs. The cherubs are positioned above a base adorned with intricate scrollwork and shell motifs. Above the urn, a cluster of small cherub faces emerges, framed with flowing lines resembling clouds or ethereal wisps. The composition is highly decorative and dynamic, showcasing graceful curves and flowing forms.

artworks.title: A Subiaco (Near Subiaco)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a rugged landscape with a flowing stream, lush vegetation, distant hills, and a subtle sun behind clouds. The engraver used intricate line work to detail textures in the natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brownish-gray. Close to us is a stream with rocks, two people near the water, and dense wooded hills. In the distance, the landscape extends into hills and mountains covered with detailed trees, giving a sense of depth and vastness.

artworks.title: Lago di Nemi (Lake Nemi)
artworks.creditLine: Rudolf Sobernheim Memorial Fund and Oscar Naumann Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view overlooking Lake Nemi. In the foreground, there is a rocky outcropping with trees and a shepherd with his sheep. A tree with a wide canopy frames the scene to the right. The horizon is high in the image, with a sky filled with clouds. The lake reflects the sky subtly. The left side of the composition shows hills, cliffs, and buildings that suggest a settlement. The palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and gray. The linework highlights the texture of the landscape.

artworks.title: Studies for Lunettes
artworks.medium: oil, graphite, charcoal, and red pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a set of sketches showing eight semi-circular sections, each depicting different themes. The scenes include "Family," "Religion," "Study," "Recreation," "Labor," and "Rest," with figures engaging in activities relevant to each theme. The sketches are in blue and green against a beige background, suggesting a preliminary conceptual layout for a larger work like a mural.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image contains pencil-drawn lines and shapes arranged in an abstract composition within an arch-shaped area at the top of the page. The lines and forms suggest figures or humanoid shapes, appearing to kneel or huddle. Some elements resemble scenery or landscape features in the background. The lines could be seen as fabric-draped figures or individuals near large, rounded objects or stones, conveying a sense of gathering or interaction.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays a composition of curved lines, undefined shapes, and a partial semicircle. Within this abstract sketch are figures that could resemble two people, potentially in seated or crouching positions. Above these figures are smaller shapes that might suggest clouds or birds. Towards the bottom right, there are vertical lines and small circles that could represent plant life, hinting at a garden or natural setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Flower [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows several elongated, slightly curved pencil lines running diagonally across the paper, creating an abstract composition of overlapping shapes.

artworks.title: Studies for a Panel
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of loose, flowing lines and soft shapes sketched in pencil, creating an abstract composition. On the left, there are lines suggesting elongated figures wearing long garments and possibly carrying something overhead resembling an umbrella. On the right side, there are abstract lines within a rectangular section hinting at figures lying horizontally, as if in beds or shallow steps. The image is characterized by indistinct edges and minimal detail, leaving room for personal interpretation and evoking forms such as people and objects in interaction or repose.

artworks.title: Study of a Scroll
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a large sheet of paper partially rolled up and lying on its side. The color palette consists of various shades of brown. The rolled paper is positioned slightly to the right of the center on a plain background. Shadowing gives a sense of depth below and around its curve.

artworks.title: Study of Figures
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures and a geometric shape. The sketch is minimalist and done in pencil on brown paper, capturing two figures on the left and right portions of the image. The figure on the left appears seated or kneeling, shrouded in long, flowing lines. To the right, another figure stands upright, with lines suggesting motion or the outline of expansive garments. Between the two figures is a slightly diagonal line. The simplicity of the lines reflects an exploration of form and pose.

artworks.title: Study of Figures in a Lunette
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows abstract compositions of two figures sketched with light, flowing lines, enclosed within a semi-circular shape resembling an arch. The forms suggest human-like shapes, with one figure appearing to be standing or in motion with an arm raised, and the other seeming to be reclined or resting. The curvature of the arc can be likened to a horizon or a shell, providing a familiar backdrop to the figures, reminiscent of a dance or interaction frozen in a minimalist sketch.

artworks.title: Study of a Figure from Behind
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the back view of a person from the head down to about the feet. The person is positioned with their back facing the viewer, appearing to be leaning or reclining. The detailed facial features are not visible, as only the back of the head is shown, featuring short, smoothed-down hair. The clothing consists of a long, flowing garment with wide sleeves that extends toward the floor. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The sketch is drawn on a plain background on tan paper, with no additional details or patterns.

artworks.title: Study of a Figure from Behind [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and watercolor sketch on paper depicting two figures. Both figures are depicted in full length. The person on the left is kneeling with their head slightly bowed, with obscured facial features by shadowing, wearing a long draped garment and a head covering. The figure on the right is standing with an extended arm, with indistinct facial features and wearing a flowing garment. The background is a plain, natural-toned paper.

artworks.title: Study of Figures [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch on a beige paper background featuring two figures. Both figures are standing upright; the one on the left is slightly turned and appears to have one arm raised. The faces are drawn as oval shapes with no detailed features, and the hair is suggested with simple lines. The clothing on each figure is shown as long, flowing garments, indicated by a few vertical and diagonal lines suggesting drapery. The sketch is light and lacks any significant detailing or jewelry. The right side of the paper shows a subtle, jagged edge. The background is blank with no additional elements depicted.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image portrays a series of curving and slanting lines forming an arc-like shape encircling a reclining figure. The central figure is sketched with fluid lines suggesting a person reclining. On the right, fluid lines hint at another form with an upward-reaching flow, resembling a person in motion or a musical instrument. The scene is enclosed within a large arch shape, with textured, horizontal lines adding depth and background to the abstract composition.

artworks.title: Study for a Lunette
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract scene featuring two figures positioned under a semi-circular arch. The central figure is seated, head slightly bent forward and supported by a hand. The other figure, standing beside, leans towards the seated figure. The background contains loosely sketched lines that might suggest drapery or environmental elements. The lines are simple and fluid, conveying motion and an intimate interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette
artworks.medium: black conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of small compositions and figures. The full drawing consists of multiple rough sketches on a light brown paper. At the top, there are three separate semi-circular sketches depicting simplified figures interacting with each other. Below these, there is another small arch-shaped sketch showing two figures. On the lower right corner, a distinct sketch shows a single figure in a dress in a dynamic pose with arms extended and holding up the hem of the dress. The use of soft pencil lines with varying pressure gives the impression of an unfinished work, possibly studies for larger compositions. The paper has been left mostly untouched, with smudges suggesting movement while drawing.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette [recto]
artworks.medium: colored pencils and charcoal on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts several semi-circular shapes arranged vertically on a muted brown background. These abstract shapes contain faintly sketched figures and forms resembling human silhouettes seated and interacting. The soft lines and subtle color shading suggest movement and depth within the compositions, evoking scenes of gatherings or conversations.

artworks.title: Studies for a Lunette [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and purple pencil on tan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple sketched figures. The page is filled with lightly sketched outlines depicting human forms in various poses, some sitting, others standing. The lines are delicate, and the figures are rendered with minimal detail, primarily conveying posture and movement. Some areas of the drawing include overlapping arcs. In the bottom right corner, there are subtle hints of shading. The overall appearance suggests it is a preparatory sketch that could serve as the groundwork for a more detailed piece.

artworks.title: Figure Study
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of crisscrossing lines and indistinct shapes swirling within a circular frame, suggesting an abstract composition. The sketchy lines form an entangled figure resembling a person hunched over. Subtle, overlapping lines create a texture reminiscent of preliminary sketches or preparatory outlines in a drawing.

artworks.title: Figure Study
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch of a partially visible human figure. The visible part of the body is shown from around the shoulders to the knees, with the upper half of the body not clearly defined. The figure appears to be in a seated or reclining position, with arms and legs bent in a relaxed posture. The facial features are not distinctly drawn, and the hair is not clearly outlined. The clothing is suggested by lines and shade marks, giving the sketch an abstract and unfinished appearance. There are no jewelry or objects present, and the background is blank, emphasizing the sketched lines.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite heightened with white on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows fluid and expressive brushstrokes creating an abstract composition with a central figure. The shapes suggest a person with arms raised, cloaked in sweeping fabric. Blue and purple strokes surround the figure, resembling waves or flowing water. The wavy lines suggest a billowing gown. The artwork invites the viewer to imagine a dancer mid-performance, evoking the familiarity of a dance performance.
